data.long_meaning: The meaning of Irwin is recorded in name-lists as “Ruling friend”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Irwin expresses “Ruling friend”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irwin total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: יִרְבִין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'rābēn' meaning friend and the Hebrew suffix 'yāh' meaning God, thus Irwin translates to friend of God in Hebrew.

in_greek.name: Ερβίνος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'erbainō' meaning to be strong or mighty, hence Irwin translates to strong or mighty man in Greek.

in_latin.name: Irvinus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Irvus' meaning mountain and the suffix '-inus' meaning friend, thus Irwin translates to friend of the mountain god in Latin.
